comparison.objective: Unload three bottles from a continuously rocking platform into bins.
comparison.physical_skill: Motion-timed grasping, transport and upright placement from a periodic moving support.
comparison.success_condition: All three bottles stand in bins and remain still; knocked-off or uncollected bottles lose credit.
comparison.reason: Tests interception and placement under periodic disturbance. The candidate instead changes a mechanism setting and evaluates the resulting motion over repeated cycles.
